finding: 90 treated patients are not evaluable at 12 months
analysis_consequence: Naive non-persistence rates would be biased.

finding: Referral delay is structurally unavailable when no completed referral exists.
analysis_consequence: Missing referral delay is not equivalent to zero delay or no referral need.
recommended_handling: Use referral status and completion date to define denominators first.

finding: Progression, hospitalisation and death are synthetic probabilistic outcomes.
analysis_consequence: Outcome associations are not effectiveness or causal estimates.
